seoTitle: Atlanta Public Schools Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Verified Atlanta Public Schools 2025-2026 student calendar with Aug 4 first day, May 22 last day, fall break, winter break, spring break, early release, PDF and ICS.
heroSummary: APS divides its 180 instructional days evenly between the two semesters. Extended Learning Days share October 13 and Election Day with teacher professional learning, and all PreK–12 students have early release on March 16.
calendarNotes: The official updated APS 2025-2026 student calendar lists 180 instructional days, with 90 days in the first semester and 90 days in the second semester. The calendar was revised and approved by the Atlanta Board of Education on June 2, 2025. APS students start on August 4, 2025 and finish on May 22, 2026. The official PDF includes Extended Learning Days on October 13 and November 4, Teacher Professional Learning Days around Indigenous Peoples' Day, Election Day, Presidents' Day, and January return, plus a PreK-12 Early Release Day on March 16. Families should distinguish student holidays, teacher professional learning, extended learning, and early release because these labels affect supervision and pickup routines differently.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Atlanta Public Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Atlanta Public Schools starts the 2025-2026 school year on Monday, August 4, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is APS Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Wednesday, October 15 through Friday, October 17, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Atlanta Public Schools in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: December Break runs December 22, 2025 through January 1, 2026. Students begin the second semester on Tuesday, January 6, 2026 after staff-focused dates on January 2 and January 5. APS also lists Winter Break from February 18-20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Atlanta Public Schools Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 6 through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does APS have early release in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The official APS calendar lists a PreK-12 Early Release Day on Monday, March 16, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: How many instructional days are in the APS 2025-2026 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official updated APS 2025-2026 calendar lists 180 instructional days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Atlanta Public Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Friday, May 22, 2026.
